items.title: GPT-6 Astra, Looped Transformers, and Hidden Reasoning
takeaways: This is early research on a new AI model design (looping the same layers multiple times) that may improve reasoning without making models bigger, but it is not yet a product you can use.
No action needed now, but worth tracking since if this becomes mainstream it could mean cheaper or more capable AI models for features like clinical note summarization or triage reasoning.
Do not redesign your architecture around this yet, the excerpt describes research and speculation, not a released tool or API you can integrate.
